summary.en: A local memory hub for multi-channel AI characters: separated memories with backups and restore, message inbox/outbox with offline queueing, model detection and binding, optional payment entry. Everything stays on the installer's machine.
summary.zh: 多端 AI 角色的本机记忆中枢：记忆分开存、能备份恢复；支持各端收发和离线暂存；能识别并绑定模型；可选支付入口。所有数据只留在安装者自己的电脑上。

repoDescription: 多端 AI 角色的本机记忆中枢：分开记、能备份恢复、可分端收发、可识别绑定模型、可选支付入口。Local memory hub for multi-channel AI characters.

zh: 记忆：按角色和客户端分开存，互不覆盖；写入前自动备份，删错一条也能恢复。
收发：电脑、手机、QQ 等端可以按端发消息，离线先存本地、上线再收；离线记忆能并回并去重。
模型接入：安装者的 AI 可直接读写记忆；会自动识别本机服务和主流厂商模型；绑定后才联网访问该模型；可用日常说话添加 API、绑定模型，同一项再改会覆盖。
支付：自动识别安装者所在国家/地区，显示当地货币和支付方式；只生成付款入口，不接触支付密码或银行卡。
本机运行：自动选择可用端口，数据只存在安装者自己的目录；能接多少端、存多少条由本机资源决定。
边界：不统计、不收集安装者或用户数据，任何收集都要先明确同意；可随时停用，停用后不启动服务、不写数据，也不影响 AI 使用。
en: Memory: separate memories per character and client, so they never overwrite each other; automatic backup before writes, and a mistakenly deleted item can be restored.
Messaging: send between desktop, phone and QQ-style clients; offline messages queue locally and arrive when back online; offline memory is merged back and deduped.

Model integration: the installer's AI reads and writes memory; local services and major providers are detected; network access to a model happens only after binding; custom APIs can be added and bound by talking, with the same key overwritten.
Payment: detects the installer region and shows local currency and methods; generates a payment entry only, never touching payment passwords or bank cards.
Local only: picks a free local port automatically and keeps data in the installer's own folder; the number of clients and records depends on local resources.

Boundaries: no usage statistics and no installer/user data collection without explicit consent; can be disabled at any time, and when disabled it starts no service, writes no data and does not affect the AI.
